prompt_contract_candidates.label: Canonical JSON Copy v3
prompt_contract_candidates.hypothesis: Live replay shows no-directive MLX often enters the tool protocol but drifts on canonical CLI/API arguments; tighter token-copy rules may reduce argument repair without leaking the planned call.

prompt_contract_candidates.label: Literal Argument Guard v1
prompt_contract_candidates.hypothesis: No-directive rows often choose the right tool but drift on arguments; stronger literal-copy rules may reduce repair burden.

prompt_contract_candidates.label: Parallel Array Required v2
prompt_contract_candidates.hypothesis: The parallel probe collapsed to no tool call under no-directive prompting; explicit array-shape rules may recover parallel calls.

prompt_contract_candidates.label: Parallel Two-Call Array v3
prompt_contract_candidates.hypothesis: CLI-live parallel replay shows no-directive MLX asks the operator for inputs already present; explicit source-count and array-shape rules may preserve the two-call contract.

prompt_contract_candidates.label: Schema Anchor v1
prompt_contract_candidates.hypothesis: No-directive CLI/API misses may improve if the model is reminded that tool names and fields are literal interface tokens.

prompt_contract_candidates.label: Schema Literal Tool-Required v2
prompt_contract_candidates.hypothesis: The first wave split exact-copy and executable visual gains; a combined contract may preserve schema obedience while reducing no-call failures.

prompt_contract_candidates.label: Tool Required Parallel v1
prompt_contract_candidates.hypothesis: No-directive visual and parallel cases may fail because the model exits the tool protocol; stronger tool-required wording should reduce no-call failures.

prompt_contract_candidates.label: Visual Next-Call State v2
prompt_contract_candidates.hypothesis: No-directive visual failures are concentrated in no-call behavior after a visual referent exists; explicit state-transition wording may reduce that collapse.

prompt_contract_candidates.label: Visual Refine Selection v5
prompt_contract_candidates.hypothesis: Wave four proved broad visual state wording did not fix the filter/refinement case; a narrower contract that prioritizes refine_selection for existing selection_id filtering may preserve visual initiation while changing the targeted wrong-tool failure.

prompt_contract_candidates.label: Literal Argument Guard v1
prompt_contract_candidates.hypothesis: No-directive rows often choose the right tool but drift on arguments; stronger literal-copy rules may reduce repair burden.

prompt_contract_candidates.label: Visual State Tool Selection v4
prompt_contract_candidates.hypothesis: Wave three recovered visual tool initiation but still chose the wrong visual tool for a filter/refinement case; state-specific selection rules may preserve tool entry while improving exact visual replay.

prompt_contract_candidates.label: Visual Tool Initiation v3
prompt_contract_candidates.hypothesis: CLI-live visual replay shows no-directive MLX often answers or defers instead of initiating the next visual tool call; a compact state-transition contract may recover tool entry before exact selector tuning.
